blocks.text: Nehemiah 7 contains 73 verses. It opens with: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed, It concludes with: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities. And when the seventh month was come, the children of Israel were in their cities. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The first-person Nehemiah memoir supplies vivid court, building, prayer, opposition, and reform testimony, but the final book also contains third-person narrative, lists, Ezra material, and editorial transitions. Neither total autobiography nor total fictionalization accounts for all the evidence.
